Reads dialogue and game instructions; filters counters and short menu labels.
Enable the Thor Auto Translate service in Android accessibility settings. The shortcut is not required.
Open a game on the upper screen. Translations appear below automatically.

Thor Auto Translate uses Android Accessibility to detect your enabled game or emulator and read its screen while it is in the foreground. Images are processed in memory and are not saved to files. Recognized text is sent to Google only when you choose an online method; on-device translation stays on this device after model download. Reading stops when you leave the game or pause translation. You can revoke access in Android settings.
I agree to this screen reading and translation use.
